description: V2 2.9.0 side test (owner 2026-11-12): isolated $1,000 PAPER ledger with exactly the $1K account rules below, run beside 2.8.0. Only the V2 version and the scanned symbols differ.

transition.equity_basis: ledger cash at a session boundary; open positions valued at zero

SMALL_ACCOUNT_PAPER.per_trade_budget: remaining aggregate allocation (owner choice 2026-10-16), at most max_per_trade_dollars
SMALL_ACCOUNT_PAPER.max_per_trade_dollars_note: Owner-authorized 2026-11-04 via scripts/set_small_account_bet.ps1: no single trade's modeled maximum loss (premium x 100 plus modeled round-trip costs) above $350. Removed at the $10,000 transition.
SMALL_ACCOUNT_PAPER.max_friction_fraction_note: Owner-authorized 2026-11-04: reject any contract whose entry bid/ask gap x 100 plus modeled round-trip costs (slippage, commissions, fees) exceeds 4% of its premium. Applied in the V2 pipeline; strategy.txt and option_selector.py are unchanged. The $1K ledger's 16 trades through 11/03 paid 7.1% round trip on average; the $10K's 26 paid 1.7%. Removed at the $10,000 transition.
SMALL_ACCOUNT_PAPER.risk_overrides_note: Owner-authorized 2026-10-16: daily loss limit 20% of equity for this ledger only (strategy value 2% restored at the $10,000 transition). Owner-authorized 2026-10-19: weekly loss limit 40% of equity for this ledger only (strategy value 5% restored at the transition). Owner-authorized 2026-11-04: at most 1 open position for this ledger (strategy value 4 restored at the transition): one trade at a time, so the $350 per-trade cap is the whole bet.
SMALL_ACCOUNT_PAPER.rule_overrides_note: Owner-authorized 2026-11-02 via scripts/set_small_account_options.ps1 tight: only options with a bid/ask gap of at most 5% of their price (strategy 10%), open interest >= 500 (100) and volume >= 50 (10). Tighten-only; removed at the $10,000 transition.
